name: Knee to wall
instructions: Stand barefoot facing a wall and place the test foot with the big toe on a tape measure that runs straight away from the wall.
Step the other foot back for balance. Keep the test heel flat on the floor the whole time.
Bend the front knee forward toward the wall, keeping the knee in line with the second toe.
Slide the foot back a little at a time until the knee only just touches the wall with the heel still down.
Record the distance from the wall to the tip of your big toe.
